items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: But it was, so he had never been in a place, I say suppose we changed jobs. So we did. He went with Maureen and I went with them. So this band worked for a while until Les and Arnoldoff, George Arnoldoff and some of the boys got this chance to go to the coast.

ctx.x: Tell me, when did you change over to right handed trombone then?

Oh I had been playing quite a few years. And how that come about, oh I had worked with Maureen and been all over the country and everything. And so I changed places with, I got tired of traveling. And there was another fellow here, a trombone artist, Lewis Taylor, he had never been out of Chicago. And he was with a very good band, a very good dance band. Let's see, what was the name of his band. I can't tell. But anyway, it was a very good outfit and the outfit was fellows like Les Hyde, Lionel Hampton, I don't…
You don't want to get that on the tape. Yeah.
